note: A15.8 baseline 2026-09-17: PARTIAL -- extract 2/2, literal 1/2, route 0/1, forbid 1/2. The consumer is `queue_consumer:unresolved:sqs`: the Keyed rule reads only the call's own argument region, and the documented v2 receive idiom passes a request VARIABLE, so the URL a few lines above is never seen. The consumer sentinel is deliberately NOT forbidden -- it is the only consumer node and the literal assertion already charges the miss; forbidding it would count one defect twice. The cell reads via=eventbus only because sqs_sns resolves EVENT_* first and the phantom event_emit:publish is present; every node that satisfied an assertion is QUEUE_*. Keyed on QUEUE_* + QUEUE_FLOWS like every A15.7 messaging cell, including the eventbus-first mechanisms (sqs_sns, azure_sb, redis, mqtt), so TypeScript/Java/C# read on the same scale as Python/Go and an EVENT_* key cannot flip to `none` when A2.9 moves broker pub/sub out of eventbus.rs. `via` still records the eventbus path when that is what fired. Measured against the installed wheel at HEAD bc42921.
